name: coordkit-marketplace
description: Claude Code orchestration: a shared bus + ledger that warns about concurrent edits (coordkit), an optional hard anti-clobber blocker (coordguard), and skill auto-activation with agents and dev-docs (skillkit).

plugins.name: skillkit
plugins.description: Skill auto-activation: a UserPromptSubmit hook matches prompts against layered skill-rules.json files (global ~/.claude/skills + per-project) and injects 'use this skill' reminders. Ships 10 specialized agents, /dev-docs context-persistence commands, and the skill-developer meta-skill. Suggest-only — never blocks.

plugins.name: coordkit
plugins.description: Same-machine coordination bus + cross-instance ledger. WARN-only: tracks who else is live in a repo and which files they touch, and surfaces it — never blocks a tool call.

plugins.name: coordguard
plugins.description: Hard anti-clobber guard. Blocks a Write/Edit when a file changed on disk since this session last saw it (a sibling Claude instance likely edited it). Bash calls are fingerprint-bracketed so this session's own shell edits (sed -i, formatters) don't false-positive. Kept separate from coordkit so the bus stays strictly never-blocks.
